integrity of the mechanical seal support system

facts.site: Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility
facts.title: unplanned release of pressure energy at HX-4120

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was no injury or loss. The potential outcome was rated 2 against the site's consequence scale, above the 0 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control EMERGENCY_ISOLATION_ON_RELEASE: the emergency isolation and depressuring on loss of containment was never verified as effective, and the accident investigation classified this as an absent or failed defence.

Control SEAL_SUPPORT_SYSTEM_INTEGRITY: the integrity of the mechanical seal support system had degraded below its design intent, and the accident investigation classified this as an absent or failed defence.

recommendations: Restore the emergency isolation and depressuring on loss of containment on HX-4120 and record the spot check before this task is next authorised.
Restore the integrity of the mechanical seal support system on HX-4120 and record the spot check before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in maintaining sealing systems on rotating equipment, specifically setting and proving mechanical seal support systems. HX-4120 (seal support coolers) is in service for barrier-fluid cooling for the hydrocarbon transfer pump family. The task proceeded during commissioning of replacement equipment while the emergency isolation and depressuring on loss of containment was never verified as effective. The pressure energy involved is held as hydraulic accumulator, and the recorded presentation was jet release, stored-energy discharge, rupture.
response.summary: On 4 November 2007 a near hit was recorded on HX-4120 at Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility during commissioning of replacement equipment; pressure energy held as hydraulic accumulator was not released.
